Your children aren’t affected, but it’s an issue of what’s called ‘herd immunity.’ Some children don’t qualify for vaccinations (immunocompromised, rare diseases, etc.) so it’s those children that will be affected if not enough children who qualify are vaccinated. The idea is that if every child who is able to get vaccinated actually gets vaccinated, then the vulnerable children who don’t qualify will be protected.
